subject: Air freight quote request: Wuppertal to New York
body:
Hello,

please quote air freight for this shipment:

- Pickup: from our site at 42346 Wuppertal, Germany (please arrange the truck)
- Destination airport: New York (JFK), US
- Commodity: cleaning agent, 11 pieces
- Gross weight: 1034 kg
- Volume: 6.62 cbm
- Ready date: 2026-11-25
- Service: the fastest option
- Our shipper's letter of instruction is attached to this email
- The goods are general cargo, non-dangerous

Please reply with your all-in price in EUR.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
